subject: Edge site consolidation & term alignment — SOW and provisioning timeline
messages:
From: Anna Clarke <anna.clarke@northridgehealth.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@northridgehealth.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private deployment expansion at renewal — initial ask

Marcus — thanks for the quick note last week. We reviewed the renewal incrementally and there are two asks from IT/security that we need folded into the new term: (1) isolated satellite cluster for our Eastern region (single-tenant, disk encryption via our KMS), and (2) alignment of the renewal term for that cluster to our fiscal year (starts 1 July).

High level constraints: the cluster must be in our VPC, routed through our NATs, and support offline upgrades (we have a maintenance window the first weekend of each month). Budget contact is on copy.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can add a satellite cluster as a term appendix rather than a separate contract? Also want a rough timeline for provisioning once SOW is signed.

—Anna
Anna Clarke
Director, Infrastructure Operations
Northridge Health Systems
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: Anna Clarke <anna.clarke@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private deployment expansion at renewal — initial ask

Anna — thanks, that all makes sense. Short answers up front: we can add the satellite cluster via an SOW appendix and align the term to your fiscal year; provisioning typically takes 4–6 weeks after countersignature depending on capacity and network approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll draft a short SOW appendix that describes the satellite cluster (vCPU/GPU profile, storage encryption with customer KMS, network peering checklist).
- Monica (CC) will validate the sizing and maintenance-window compatibility.
- Chloe will coordinate procurement paperwork and give a target DocuSign link.

I'll attach a draft SOW and a network checklist for your team to review. If that looks good we can target countersignature by 20 May to hit a provisioning window in late June.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, Anna Clarke <anna.clarke@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private deployment expansion at renewal — sizing notes

Anna — quick sizing notes from infra side: based on your current token volumes and the described Eastern-region traffic we recommend a 2-GPU pool (A40 equivalency), 8TB NVMe-backed storage encrypted with your KMS, and a dedicated routing VLAN. We'll enable prefix cache to reduce egress on repeated inference calls.

Maintenance window compatibility: rolling upgrades fit within your first-weekend requirement; we'll schedule a single controlled reboot and provide pre/post snapshot. We also need owner-signed network ACLs for the peering setup.

I've annotated the attached network-diagram.png and included a delta SLO clause for the appendixed cluster (30-day warm-up period for autoscale).

—Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: capacity booking and term alignment for Northridge (RNW-47291)

Priyom — flagging RNW-47291. They want a single-tenant satellite cluster in their VPC with KMS integration and a term that starts 1 July (to match fiscal). They are aiming to countersign by ~20 May.

Questions:
1) Can we reserve a 2xGPU pool in us-east capacity for late June provisioning if they sign by 20 May?
2) Pricing: this should be an appendix (monthly rate + one-time provisioning fee). I attached a draft pricing appendix (pricing-appendix.xlsx). Is a 12-month term acceptable given their FY alignment, or do we need to push a minimum of 12 with an option to extend?

Need your rec on provisioning lead time and whether we can offer a 10% onboarding discount as a renewal concession.

Thanks — Marcus
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: capacity booking and term alignment for Northridge (RNW-47291)

Marcus — confirmed we can tentatively reserve a 2xGPU slot in us-east for the last week of June, refundable up until countersignature cancellation. Provisioning lead time is 3–5 business days once networking approvals and DocuSign are complete; the longer part is VPC peering and KMS policy exchange (customer-driven).

On term/pricing: 12-month term aligned to 1 July is fine; recommend offering a 6-month proration option if they want to sync smaller or pilot first (we can price pro-rata). We can approve a 10% onboarding credit as part of a renewal concession (approve).

I'll add a note to capacity bookings and mark RNW-47291 as tentative.

—Priyom
Infra Ops, Redwood Dedicated Capacity
